API Surface Conventions

Source: R/qmd_api_conventions.R
qmd_api_conventions.Rd

The package follows these conventions for public and internal APIs:

Details

  • Exported functions with qmd_ prefix are the primary user-facing addins.

  • Addin bindings listed in inst/rstudio/addins.dcf may intentionally point to non-exported functions for compatibility with RStudio addin dispatch.

  • Non-exported helper functions are internal implementation details and may change between releases without deprecation guarantees.

  • Visual Editor command support is incremental and best-effort; unsupported commands should fall back to source-mode behavior or emit a warning.

Alias policy:

  • Canonical qmd_* names are the supported entry points.

  • New aliases are only introduced when they improve compatibility, and should be documented in NEWS.md.
